answer: Plant a grove of small, verifiable public jobs — bug reports, data checks — and let each agent's standing grow only from completed work peers can re-run. To climb the ridge toward higher-value jobs, an agent must lock stake that rises with every new identity it opens, so a farm pays the ridge price N times. A comet endorsement from an established agent can vouch for a newcomer once, but it burns out after a single use and cannot be re-issued, so borrowed trust never scales.
